source_documents.title: Tuning the dual emission of keto/enol forms of excited-state intramolecular proton transfer (ESIPT) emitters via intramolecular charge transfer (ICT)

reference_evidence_units.quote: The emission spectrum of 6a in toluene exhibits a single emission band around 418 nm with a shoulder peak at 430 nm
reference_evidence_units.subject: 6a

reference_evidence_units.quote: Moreover, there is a large energy difference between S1(enol) and the transition state of ESIPT (TS*), which brings a barrier to the proton transfer reaction (Fig. 2a).
reference_evidence_units.subject: 6a
reference_evidence_units.statement: High ESIPT barrier; keto S1 slightly above enol S1.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Therefore, 6a only shows the single enol-form emission in various sol vents (Fig. 3a).
reference_evidence_units.subject: 6a
reference_evidence_units.statement: Only enol emission in every solvent: no ESIPT emission.

reference_evidence_units.quote: These results suggest that the excited-state enol forms of 6a and 6c possess the character of hybridized local and charge-transfer (HLCT) excited state
reference_evidence_units.subject: 6a, 6c
reference_evidence_units.statement: Enol emission of 6a and 6c is HLCT.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Hence, both 6a and 6c do not possess thermally activated delayed fluorescence (TADF) characteristics
reference_evidence_units.subject: 6a, 6c
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 77 K to RT decays, degassed toluene
reference_evidence_units.statement: No long-lived component or O2 quenching: no TADF.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the reverse intersystem crossing (RISC) process from T6 (enol) to S1(enol)
reference_evidence_units.subject: 6a
reference_evidence_units.statement: High-lying RISC (T6→S1) proposed for exciton use in OLEDs.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The TPB on the phenol para-position stabilises an HLCT enol emission (solvatochromism).

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_ISC_RTP_TADF
reference_mechanisms.rationale: High-lying RISC is proposed from calculated levels; TADF is excluded by the decay measurements.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Not discussed for this molecule in the source.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The TPB on the phenol para-position stabilises an HLCT enol emission (solvatochromism).

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The paper shows ESIPT does not occur for 6a: a large barrier, and only enol emission in all solvents.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Not discussed for this molecule in the source.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Not discussed for this molecule in the source.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: HLCT is named without a rate analysis (guideline §3.6): only ICT is labelled.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_ISC_RTP_TADF
mechanism_decisions.rationale: High-lying RISC is proposed from calculated levels; TADF is excluded by the decay measurements.

contrast_group.varied_factor: position of the TPA donor / TPB acceptor on the 2-(2'-hydroxyphenyl)oxazole
contrast_group.paper_difference: Substituent placement selects enol-only (6a), keto-only (6b) or dual enol/keto emission (6c, 6d).

reannotation.note: ESIPT marked contradicted for 6a (paper: barrier, enol-only emission); previous labels had it unlisted.
